newsitem.title: USA: HDS Network gets NC order from U.S. agency.
newsitem.headline: HDS Network gets NC order from U.S. agency.

text.p: HDS Network Systems Inc on Monday said it has received a $1.5 million order to supply Network Computers and related services to the U.S. Forest Service.
All of the equipment and services ordered are scheduled to ship within the current and next fiscal quarters, HDS said.
Network Computers are low-cost, stripped-down computers that access the internet and other networks.

The U.S. Forest Service is deploying the HDS Network Computers for geographic information system requirements nationwide, along with supporting administrative, scientific and technical needs including office automation, software development, and management information.
